idea-plugin.name: Git Swimlanes
idea-plugin.description: Deterministic Git history visualizer. Renders branches as stable, labeled swimlanes whose colors are a pure function of the branch name — the same branch is always the same color, in every repository and on every render. Detects pull/merge requests from commit messages (Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, squash), shows per-commit file changes, and opens a colored diff for any file on click.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.0.0 — initial release: swimlane graph, PR detection, per-file diff viewer.
